name: Brecht F. Verbeken
description: Economist (PhD) and mathematician (MSc) by training; data scientist with strong interests in economics and AI and a passion for mathematics.

appointments.title: Guest Professor (10%)
appointments.description: Course holder for Mathematics II for Business Economics (6 ECTS); teaching, assessment and master’s-thesis supervision.

appointments.title: Postdoctoral Researcher (90%)
appointments.description: Research in model evaluation, AI in science and mathematics, and stochastic systems; institutional AI workflows and interdisciplinary collaboration.

appointments.title: Research Associate
appointments.description: Research on uplift-model evaluation and semi-Markov processes; mathematics teaching and thesis supervision.

appointments.title: Doctoral Researcher
appointments.description: Stochastic models for manpower planning; collaboration on economic nowcasting and ergodicity economics; teaching duties.

education.description: On Models and Metrics: Improving Stochastic Model Performance in Manpower Planning.

mathematics: Ramsey theory as a setting for AI-assisted research

collaboration_role: Often helps set the research agenda and lead collaborations; has done so since the early years of his PhD.

PhD advisory committee membership and doctoral progress assessment
